day.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: original panoramic decorative website footer-bottom cover for Gredice, a gardening and raised-bed service with a playful low-poly 3D visual identity.
Primary request: create ONE polished, exceptionally wide 3:1 landscape image, ideally 3072 by 1024 pixels. Artwork only, no UI mockup.
Scene: a beautiful miniature vegetable garden spreading continuously from left to right across the bottom of the canvas, viewed at a gently elevated three-quarter angle, with layered soft green hills in the distance. Three honey-colored timber raised beds with dark soil, sculptural lettuces, red tomatoes and small young seedlings, a subtle winding cream gravel path connecting them, a small simple greenhouse in the right-middle distance, a handful of leafy low-poly trees, sunflowers as taller accents near the edges. Keep this an open, well-composed garden rather than a dense farm.
Style: premium faceted 3D game illustration with clean broad polygon planes, chunky bevelled geometry, matte tactile materials, convincing volume and soft ambient occlusion. Crisp art direction, not a photograph, not painterly, no grain, no textural noise. Color palette of lively leaf greens, teal accents, warm natural timber, coral tomatoes, golden sunflower petals and cream path. Clear neutral daylight from upper left, no overall yellow color cast.
Composition: a true extra-wide horizontal panorama, no frame, no inset, no collage. Stretch the garden across the entire canvas; most objects live in the bottom 65 percent. Uppermost 20 percent is completely plain pure white, with the distant landscape gently fading up into that white, allowing a clean transition into a white webpage footer above. An irregular natural garden skyline. The lower edge is filled with lush garden ground and low vegetation; scene runs to both side edges. The middle must remain attractive when cropped on mobile. Beautiful readable shapes at small display sizes.
Constraints: NO text, NO lettering, NO logo, NO watermark, NO people, NO faces, NO mascot, NO floating isolated islands, NO UI, NO decorative border. A single coherent uninterrupted wide scene.
